terminal_boundary.detail: Four authority CREATE attempts returned CREATE_EXISTS. Pool unified hash sharding should have started from index 3 using beacon_commit_sha but the first attempt used index 2; the hard four-attempt ceiling prevents a corrective fifth claim.

friction_events.description: Four authority CREATE attempts returned the exact CREATE_EXISTS collision signature.
POOL unified hash sharding was not applied before the first claim attempt; later detection forced a safe stop at the hard attempt cap.

decision_trace.decision: Create a de-novo v3.30 worker identity before allocation.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Fresh-launch policy required the beacon as the first durable worker-side write.
decision_trace.action: Created the beacon with a new worker_id and launch_nonce.
decision_trace.outcome: Fresh identity became durable and frozen for this launch.

decision_trace.decision: Treat each GitHub 422 sha-not-supplied response as CREATE_EXISTS.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The bootstrap defines that exact signature as an ownership collision.
decision_trace.action: Advanced to other retained candidates without pre-reading claim paths.
decision_trace.outcome: Four authority attempts all collided; no authority was won.

decision_trace.decision: Stop instead of issuing a fifth corrective claim.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The POOL contract hard-caps total authority CREATE attempts at four; audit detected the first attempt did not follow the required hash start index.
decision_trace.action: Persisted a truthful no-allocation boundary and terminal exam.
decision_trace.outcome: Worker closed with zero productive units and no fabricated ownership or exhaustion claim.

top_time_sinks.note: Repeated atomic collisions consumed the bounded claim budget.
Incorrect initial POOL sharding selection prevented a lawful corrective fifth attempt.

unfinished_debt.item: The retained compatible candidate portfolio-elastic-kernel-capability-pressure-verification-v1 was not lawfully attempted by this worker because the four-attempt ceiling had already been consumed.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Enforce POOL/BATCH hash-index selection mechanically before exposing any authority CREATE action.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Prevents lane-order fallback from consuming claim budget and improves worker dispersion under contention.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 PROD-01 worker created successfully. Four bounded authority claims collided. The worker detected that its initial POOL routing did not follow required hash sharding and stopped at the hard attempt ceiling without claiming ownership, inventing productive work, or asserting frontier exhaustion.
